oracle.name: Power Pages portal Web API
oracle.scope: Two signed-in browser runs of a batched recorder on the demo site (the demo portal with the baseline fixture site over it) writing and reading owned account, contact and note rows through the portal Web API: string values at each column's limits, typed values, malformed and raw bodies, token omission and replacement, content types, lookups and filtered queries. Establishes each request's status, error code and message and what a read-back of the row finds, with the demo's plug-in steps active. It does not establish inner error texts, response headers or formatting. Run markers and record ids are replaced; the exact hosted build is unrecorded.

error.message: Attribute value in table account is not enabled for Web Api.
